ambiguities: Ridge target is single fit with y_home=home regulation goals, y_away=away regulation goals (target present for all pool games).
Pool/ridge games use all kept games (type 2 and 3); date grouping uses x.gameDate, not file name.
Team penalty diagonal covers all teams in all kept games (global team list); absent teams get LAM-only diagonal.
Kernel team rows with missing x (ridge missing) are excluded as references and produce missing output.
MIN_REF counted after applying present-x and condition filters; missing season means no earlier season rows => missing.
Goals whose teamAbbrev is not home are credited to away; goals with missing periodDescriptor are skipped.
ppc_cov uses same kernel weights for all three expectations with x_tot present refs only.
Game season uses first four digits of x.season; 'season >= S-1' on that integer.
Row order: games sorted by (date, game_id), home row then away row; floats written with 17 significant digits.
